parameters.content:
## WF8b — Social publish (hardened)

Requires `N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN` on incoming webhooks and `NEXUS_APP_URL` + `N8N_INGEST_TOKEN` for app callbacks.

Reads the post + signed media URL from `GET /api/internal/n8n/social-post` (no Supabase REST). Terminal status is written via `POST /api/internal/n8n/post-result`. Same-workflow Error Trigger writes `failed` if a node throws.
